Players Committee card image of [[Are You Okay?]] (original printing), game text: “Subtract 2 from a just drawn destiny targeting the ability or defense value of your non-Jedi [Episode VII] character. OR If you just forfeited a character from a Jakku site during your turn, use 1 Force to deploy that character from Lost Pile to same site for free.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/areyouokay.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
